title: UFUND Risk Portfolio Dashboard
headline: Making portfolio performance visible.
summary: Portfolio reporting that brings approval, contract and risk performance into a connected analytical view.
tools: Power BI, SQL Server, Python, Excel
coverNote: Project description based on Sofwan’s resume. The cover is an illustration; no internal dashboard screenshot or business data is displayed.

blocks.html:
The question

How can business and risk teams monitor a portfolio consistently across different stages and customer segments?

The approach

Transform and validate portfolio data with SQL and Python, then present performance in Power BI. Examine AppIn, approval, contracts, FPD2, NPL, MOB4/MOB6 and DPD.

What it enables

A more consistent basis for reviewing performance across customer age, location, income, student status, risk level and other portfolio segments.
